source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Ship in the Grey Ice
tts_text: The research ship lay still, surrounded by grey ice. The climate there changed faster than anywhere on earth, and the mood on board changed with it. Under such circumstances, the captain kept a strict circle of habits. Every morning the crew ran one circuit of the deck, and warm air circulated through the cabins. When the ice cracked, the whole ship would leap like a nervous animal. The captain conducted the journey from a small room behind the bridge. He could direct the ship with one hand: a short command, a clear direction. He instructed the young sailors in a low voice, and no one argued. He had been in the military for twenty years. Each evening the radio officer would broadcast the weather. His forecast was never perfect. We cannot foresee the ice, he said; we can only guess. From the fore part of the ship the lookout watched the white distance, and land came into sight at last. There was no time for sightseeing. The captain had to oversee the whole deck, and his one oversight was a forgotten rope. His insight was simple: the ice always tells the truth. He pushed forward, and the ship moved forth into open water. A small camera was on board to capture pictures of the ice. The captain was capable of reading them better than any scientist. The hold had the capacity to carry two hundred boxes of samples, and for this small crew the ship itself was their capital.

sentences_cn: 那艘科考船一动不动地停着，四周全是灰白色的冰。
那里的气候变化比地球上任何地方都快，船上的气氛也跟着变。
在这种情形下，船长守着一整套固定的习惯。
每天早上，船员们都要绕甲板跑一圈，暖空气在船舱里循环流动。
冰一裂开，整条船就像受惊的动物一样猛地跳起来。
船长在驾驶台后面的小舱里指挥整段航程。
他一只手就能指挥这条船：一句简短的命令，一个明确的方向。
他低声指导年轻的水手，没有人顶嘴。
他在军队里待了二十年。
每天晚上，报务员都会播报天气。
他的预报从来都不完美。
“我们没法预见冰情，”他说，“只能猜。”
在船的前部，瞭望员盯着白茫茫的远方，终于看见了陆地。
没有时间观光。
船长必须监督整个甲板，而他唯一的一次疏忽，是一根被遗忘的绳子。
他的洞察很简单：冰从不说谎。
他向前推进，船驶进了开阔的水域。
船上有一台小相机，用来拍下冰的样子。
船长解读这些照片的能力，比任何科学家都强。
货舱能装两百箱样本，而对这几个船员来说，这条船本身就是他们的资本。
